sections.title: Section 1: Things To Do Before We Go
sections.html:
cancel

(verb). hủy

I'm sorry, but I'm afraid I have to cancel our date today.

appointment

(noun). cuộc hẹn

Remember to book an appointment with the doctor.

hairdresser

(noun). thợ cắt tóc, người làm tóc

She is now working as a hairdresser in this salon.

remind

(verb). nhắc lại, làm ai đó nhớ

I marked the calendar to remind myself of my appointment with the dentist.

tablet

(noun). thuốc

You need to take one of these tablets every day until you feel better.

pharmacy

(noun). hiệu thuốc

You can find this medicine at a local pharmacy.

malaria

(noun). bệnh sốt rét

Some types of mosquitoes can cause malaria, which can quickly become deadly if not treated.

sunblock

(noun). kem chống nắng

Put on your sunblock before you go swimming, or else you will get sunburnt.

sunglasses

(noun). kính râm

Did you remember to bring your sunglasses?

spare

(adjective). dự phòng

I lost the key to my house while I was outside, but luckily I had some spare keys.

lock

(noun). khóa

This lock can only be opened by this key.

flimsy

(adjective). mỏng manh, dễ hư

This table looks so flimsy. Are you sure we can put things on it?

adaptor/adapter

(noun). thiết bị để đổi ổ cắm điện

I always remember to bring my travel adaptor along with me on holiday.

beforehand / in advance

(adverb). trước

Planning your meals out in advance / beforehand can help you to develop healthier eating habits.

vet / veterinarian

(noun). bác sĩ thú y

I love animals so much, so my dream job is to become a vet.

treble

(verb). nhân ba (x3)

He has trebled his earnings in just a year.

landmark

(noun). cột mốc

The Eiffel tower is one of the landmarks of Paris.

church

(noun). nhà thờ

We go to church every Sunday morning.

suitcase

(noun). va li

I'm at the airport waiting for my suitcase to arrive.

struggle

(verb). chật vật, gặp khó khăn

She didn't sleep well last night and is now struggling to stay awake.

sections.title: Section 2: Adbourne Film Festival
sections.html:
encourage

(verb). cổ vũ, khuyến khích

Parents should encourage their kids to study hard.

release

(verb). thả ra, giải phóng

At the start of the school year, we usually release many balloons into the air.

allocate

(verb). phân phối tiền, thời gian cho việc gì đó

I allocate a different amount of money to each goal.

fund

(noun). tiền quỹ

We are trying to raise funds to help poor people.

promote

(verb). quảng cáo, lăng xê

If you don't promote yourself, no one else will.

obtain

(verb). lấy được, đạt được

I finally obtained the keys to my first home.

restrict >> restricted (adj)

(verb). giới hạn

I can't open the file because they have restricted the access to it.

green

(adjective). thân thiện với môi trường

Cycling is a green mode of transportation because it doesn't cause pollution.

theme

(noun). chủ đề

The theme for the birthday party is animals.

documentary

(noun). phim tài liệu

When I was young, I used to watch nature documentaries every day.

cycle

(verb). đạp xe

I saw a group of people cycling in the park today.

donate

(verb). quyên góp

I'd like to donate these old shirts to charity because they're still in good condition.

deadline

(noun). hạn chót

I need to finish my report before the deadline.

application form

(noun). đơn ứng tuyển

You need to fill in this application form.

persuade

(verb). thuyết phục

She persuaded them to listen to her ideas.

memorable

(adjective). đáng nhớ

Many big brands have memorable logos.

originality

(noun). tính độc đáo, tính sáng tạo, tính mới mẻ

You need to stand out from the crowd by showing originality.

judge

(noun). giám khảo

The judges all gave him the highest score.

topical

(adjective). mang tính chất thời sự

COVID-19 is still one of the most topical events that is happening right now.

propaganda

(noun). tài liệu tuyên truyền

Back then in China, there was a lot of political propaganda that was pushed by the government.

angle

(noun). góc độ, góc nhìn

Everyone looks at the problem from a different angle.

additional

(adjective). thêm vào, tăng thêm

You should find a part-time job to gain some addtional income.

class

(noun). thể loại

Animals are divided into several different classes.

venue

(noun). địa điểm

We have just agreed on the venue for the wedding.

expertise

(noun). kiến thức chuyên môn

His expertise in technology makes him a valuable employee.

submit

(verb). nộp

She submitted the report to her manager.

sections.title: Section 3: Research On Web-Based Crosswords
sections.html:
familiar

(adjective). quen thuộc

They might have met her before, so she looks familiar to them.

cover

(verb). bao gồm

There was so much to cover in the presentation that it lasted for hours.

straightforward

(adjective). dễ hiểu, không phức tạp

The process is very straightforward: you just need to follow these three steps and then it's done.

concept

(noun). khái niệm

Travelling to different countries helps you to have a concept of cultures.

persuade / convince

(verb). thuyết phục

She persuaded them to listen to her ideas.

participant

(noun). người tham gia

There were nine participants in the meeting.

questionnaire

(noun). trắc nghiệm, bản điều tra

He asked me to complete a questionnaire

misleading

(adjective). gây hiểu nhầm

Advertisements can be misleading sometimes.

obsolete

(adjective). lạc hậu, lỗi thời

Mobile phones have made home phones obsolete.

take aback

(adjective). gây ngạc nhiên

She was taken aback by what she just saw.

disappointed

(adjective). thất vọng

He's disappointed because he lost his job.

complex

(adjective). phức tạp, khó hiểu

The problem is so complex that he cannot solve it.

distracted

(adjective). bị phân tâm

I tried to focus on my homework, but I was distracted by my phone.

respondent

(noun). người trả lời

Would you like to be a respondent to our short survey?

highlight

(verb). nhấn mạnh

The teacher highlighted the main ideas in the textbook, which we will need to study for the test.

gender

(noun). giới tính

Do you know the gender of the baby yet?

assessment

(noun). bài đánh giá, kiểm tra

Students need to do an assessment at the end of the course

reference

(verb). chú thích tham khảo

Don't forget to reference your sources at the end of your paper.

collaborate

(verb). hợp tác

Everyone in the team needs to collaborate on this project.

instrument

(noun). công cụ

When working in a lab, you need to get used to all these different instruments.

acknowledge

(verb). công nhận

It feels good when others acknowledge the good work that you've done for them.

crossword

(noun). ô chữ

There's a new crossword in the newspaper every day.

revise >> revision (n)

(verb). ôn tập

She has a lot to revise before the final exam.

article

(noun). bài báo

Have you seen this article today?

apprentice

(noun). người tập sự

He's working as an apprentice in the workshop.

sections.title: Section 4: Job Satisfaction Study
sections.html:
investigate

(verb). điều tra

They are investigating the accident.

call center

(noun). trung tâm xử lý cuộc gọi chăm sóc khách hàng

His new job is working at a call center.

apparent

(adjective). rõ ràng

It's apparent that the bananas on the left aren't good enough to eat yet.

statistical >> statistically (adv)

(adjective). về mặt số liệu

I'm currently studying statistical analysis.

inconclusive

(adjective). không đủ chắc chắn để đưa ra kết luận

The discussion about the issue was hard to understand and inconclusive.

analyze

(verb). phân tích

In a research, you need to carry out data analysis.

identify

(verb). xác minh, nhận diện

How can we identify the right person we are looking for?

methodology

(noun). hệ thống phương pháp

The teacher applied the new teaching methodology.

sub-group

(noun). nhóm nhỏ

Each group is then divided into even smaller sub-groups.

unequal

(adjective). không bằng nhau

Even though their job is the same, their salaries are unequal.

ignore

(verb). bỏ qua, lơ đi

You should ignore what people say about you behind your back.

circumstance

(noun). hoàn cảnh, tình huống

Our flight was cancelled because of terrible weather circumstances.

distribution

(noun). sự phân phát

How should we handle the distribution of money among us?

control

(verb). kiểm soát

In this game, you will use this device to control your character.

ensure

(verb). đảm bảo

Wearing a helmet helps to ensure the safety of builders.

sample

(noun). nhóm mẫu, mẫu thí nghiệm

They do interviews with a sample of students

administer

(verb). quản lý

Nurses and doctors can administer vaccines to people.

supervise

(verb). giám sát

Our boss is always supervising our work.

colleague

(noun). đồng nghiệp

I am lucky to have good colleagues.

eliminate

(verb). loại bỏ

Scientists are looking for ways to eliminate COVID-19.

reassure

(verb). cam đoan, đảm bảo

The doctor reassured her that nothing bad would happen in the future.

unwilling

(adjective). không sẵn lòng

The boy is unwilling to go to school.

confidential

(adjective). bí mật

The information in the e-mail should be kept confidential.

withdraw

(verb). rút ra, rút lui

He withdrew from the group activity.

summarize

(verb). tóm tắt

Summarizing a long paper is not an easy task.

job satisfaction

(noun). sự hài lòng với công việc

The level of job satisfaction among our employees is high.

recommendation

(noun). gợi ý, đề xuất

I talked to my friends and they gave me some good recommendations on what I need to do.

remove

(verb). bỏ đi, bỏ ra chỗ khác

She removes her makeup before going to bed.
